narrative_prose: Ryn slammed the heavy brass ladle against the steaming kettle of braised mire-lentils. The sharp tang of ozone and burning copper insulation still clung to the air from the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea outside, but in here, the air tasted of rich marrow and toasted iron-wheat. She watched Silas step into the galley, his shoulders heavy, and she shoved a perfectly portioned biscuit into his hand before he could speak.
summary: Ryn reflects on the shear storm while serving a nourishing biscuit to Silas in the galley.
